suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-12 adds this draft-primary relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. The clinical review identifies anterior uveitis among the extra-articular features often seen with reactive arthritis. Require established reactive arthritis and separately documented anterior uveitis by appropriate ophthalmic evaluation. Do not infer uveitis from reactive arthritis, conjunctivitis, red eye, ocular irritation, or photophobia alone. Preserve infectious uveitis, HLA-B27-associated uveitis from another spondyloarthritis, sarcoidosis, inflammatory bowel disease, medication-related disease, trauma, and other ocular inflammatory causes. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
